subject: Re: Live screen needs
body: All yes. sensing.start(profile, onEvent, {stateId, source, mode, onFrame, onGate, onRecovered}) returns {stop()}. onFrame gives SignalFrames at about 1 Hz for the HR/RR chart. onGate every 5 s gives {confidence, position, consecutive, required, refractoryRemainingS, calibrationMode} so you can show windows, refractory and sham. sensing.manual() is for the I'm off button, and connectStrap() must be called from a click. I'll pin sensing/scenarios/demo.json to drift about 20 s into Live; send me your script beats when you have them.
